ctx.x: Yes, remember we played just a few gigs engagements. Too bad that it didn't come off, but it needed financing. It was way ahead of its time because I think Benny was not to -- Lionel and Teddy were not to join Benny Goodman until --

items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Benny Carter, Lester Young was on, Chu Berry, Bud Freeman did a lot of them.

ctx.x: That individuality, yeah. Original style. Well, I don't think it was original, I think it was inspired too much by Armstrong. But it was -- in a girl, there was nothing like it. And of course the musicians got -- I was

more excited about the musicians we had on those dates than I was about Billie, because we had Johnny Hodges, whom I'd been idolizing for years; Benny Carter, Lester Young was on, Chu Berry, Bud Freeman did a lot of them. Benny Goodman was on clarinet on a lot of them, Ben Webster on tenor, Roy Eldridge, Charlie Shavers, Bobby Hackett and Doc Cheatham and Irving Randolph. We used to call him --
